review_requirements: Confirm the exact title/NCT/date match and that both 12 July 2022 documents governed the study before its 1 August 2022 start.
Confirm the four-primary-outcome hierarchy and define study-wide multiplicity across four outcomes and two follow-up contrasts.
Preserve the randomized Amped-PD-versus-Active-Control contrast; do not substitute the reference plan's within-group repeated tests.
Specify populations, estimands, missing-data handling, intercurrent-event strategies, endpoint derivations, effect estimates and confidence intervals.
Reconcile the protocol age range of 40-80 years with any registry or operational eligibility version before freeze.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
notes: First-pass evidence-backed annotation. The compact protocol and independent SAP share exact identity and a prerecruitment date. The reference contributes the test-selection program, but it leaves substantial implementation choices unresolved and its within-group analyses are supportive rather than substitutes for randomized effects.
